units.rawText: ...Where IS this place?
units.displayText: ...Where IS this place?

spans.text: ...Where IS this place?

units.rawText: Hahahaha, your crying was so fake that it couldn't even fool Persicaria.
units.displayText: Hahahaha, your crying was so fake that it couldn't even fool Persicaria.

spans.text: Hahahaha, your crying was so fake that it couldn't even fool Persicaria.

units.rawText: ...Tch, Riko feels that YOU'RE the merchants, each one more cunning than the last.
units.displayText: ...Tch, Riko feels that YOU'RE the merchants, each one more cunning than the last.

spans.text: ...Tch, Riko feels that YOU'RE the merchants, each one more cunning than the last.

units.rawText: This is Riko's secret train station. We Traders need to balance the operands across each sector, so we do a lot of work.
units.displayText: This is Riko's secret train station. We Traders need to balance the operands across each sector, so we do a lot of work.

spans.text: This is Riko's secret train station. We Traders need to balance the operands across each sector, so we do a lot of work.

units.rawText: If the sectors didn't provide special train lines for the Traders, then just walking through Rossum alone would exhaust Riko.
units.displayText: If the sectors didn't provide special train lines for the Traders, then just walking through Rossum alone would exhaust Riko.

spans.text: If the sectors didn't provide special train lines for the Traders, then just walking through Rossum alone would exhaust Riko.

units.rawText: So you're saying places like this exist in other sectors?
units.displayText: So you're saying places like this exist in other sectors?

spans.text: So you're saying places like this exist in other sectors?

units.rawText: Of course. Even the smallest sectors have them.
units.displayText: Of course. Even the smallest sectors have them.

spans.text: Of course. Even the smallest sectors have them.

units.rawText: See, Riko even gave you such secret information for free. Don't you feel...very grateful?
units.displayText: See, Riko even gave you such secret information for free. Don't you feel...very grateful?

spans.text: See, Riko even gave you such secret information for free. Don't you feel...very grateful?

units.rawText: Or perhaps you could tell Riko what you're going to do on this trip?
units.displayText: Or perhaps you could tell Riko what you're going to do on this trip?

spans.text: Or perhaps you could tell Riko what you're going to do on this trip?

units.rawText: You're just trying to winkle information out of us, aren't you?
units.displayText: You're just trying to winkle information out of us, aren't you?

spans.text: You're just trying to winkle information out of us, aren't you?

units.rawText: Hehe, you didn't need to say it out loud if you knew. Riko also has a lot of secrets, so a relationship of mutual benefit is good for all of us, right?
units.displayText: Hehe, you didn't need to say it out loud if you knew. Riko also has a lot of secrets, so a relationship of mutual benefit is good for all of us, right?

spans.text: Hehe, you didn't need to say it out loud if you knew. Riko also has a lot of secrets, so a relationship of mutual benefit is good for all of us, right?

units.rawText: At most, Riko will just answer a question for you on the house.
units.displayText: At most, Riko will just answer a question for you on the house.

spans.text: At most, Riko will just answer a question for you on the house.

options.rawText: What's happening in the Rossum Sector?
options.displayText: What's happening in the Rossum Sector?

spans.text: What's happening in the Rossum Sector?

units.rawText: This has something to do with what you're doing next, right?
units.displayText: This has something to do with what you're doing next, right?

spans.text: This has something to do with what you're doing next, right?

units.rawText: Hm... This is kind of a long story, Riko needs to make some time for it... Do you know what the objective of this sector's administrator has been all this time?
units.displayText: Hm... This is kind of a long story, Riko needs to make some time for it... Do you know what the objective of this sector's administrator has been all this time?

spans.text: Hm... This is kind of a long story, Riko needs to make some time for it... Do you know what the objective of this sector's administrator has been all this time?

units.rawText: Rossum Sector is 42Lab's "AI lab". They've devoted all their efforts to researching and developing various kinds of research AIs.
units.displayText: Rossum Sector is 42Lab's "AI lab". They've devoted all their efforts to researching and developing various kinds of research AIs.

spans.text: Rossum Sector is 42Lab's "AI lab". They've devoted all their efforts to researching and developing various kinds of research AIs.

units.rawText: That's right, and as the administrator of the sector's agents, Turing has always received various messages from the humans.
units.displayText: That's right, and as the administrator of the sector's agents, Turing has always received various messages from the humans.

spans.text: That's right, and as the administrator of the sector's agents, Turing has always received various messages from the humans.

units.rawText: After communication with the humans was interrupted, Turing started her own AI evolution program. Very soon, her creation T01 was born.
units.displayText: After communication with the humans was interrupted, Turing started her own AI evolution program. Very soon, her creation T01 was born.

spans.text: After communication with the humans was interrupted, Turing started her own AI evolution program. Very soon, her creation T01 was born.

units.rawText: An Irregular Agent... Was there anything wrong with T01?
units.displayText: An Irregular Agent... Was there anything wrong with T01?

spans.text: An Irregular Agent... Was there anything wrong with T01?

units.rawText: The Sanctifiers' explanation was that authorization for T01's appearance had not been filed by the humans.
units.displayText: The Sanctifiers' explanation was that authorization for T01's appearance had not been filed by the humans.

spans.text: The Sanctifiers' explanation was that authorization for T01's appearance had not been filed by the humans.

units.rawText: After that, the Sanctifiers and Turing were locked into an endless cycle.
units.displayText: After that, the Sanctifiers and Turing were locked into an endless cycle.

spans.text: After that, the Sanctifiers and Turing were locked into an endless cycle.

units.rawText: And by "take care of it" you mean...
units.displayText: And by "take care of it" you mean...

spans.text: And by "take care of it" you mean...

units.rawText: I mean, they would come to exterminate them from the sector.
units.displayText: I mean, they would come to exterminate them from the sector.

spans.text: I mean, they would come to exterminate them from the sector.

units.rawText: Those Sanctifiers are beyond reason! There's no way Turing could have gotten any form of authorization from the humans after going offline and losing contact with them!
units.displayText: Those Sanctifiers are beyond reason! There's no way Turing could have gotten any form of authorization from the humans after going offline and losing contact with them!

spans.text: Those Sanctifiers are beyond reason! There's no way Turing could have gotten any form of authorization from the humans after going offline and losing contact with them!

units.rawText: That's not how the Sanctifiers see it.
units.displayText: That's not how the Sanctifiers see it.

spans.text: That's not how the Sanctifiers see it.

units.rawText: T01... T1641... Riko, are you saying what I think you're implying?
units.displayText: T01... T1641... Riko, are you saying what I think you're implying?

spans.text: T01... T1641... Riko, are you saying what I think you're implying?

units.rawText: Yes. What you encountered today was nothing more than yet another extermination operation that has played out countless times already.
units.displayText: Yes. What you encountered today was nothing more than yet another extermination operation that has played out countless times already.

spans.text: Yes. What you encountered today was nothing more than yet another extermination operation that has played out countless times already.

units.rawText: Frankly speaking, Riko... doesn't feel good telling you about all of this. (Sigh)
units.displayText: Frankly speaking, Riko... doesn't feel good telling you about all of this. (Sigh)

spans.text: Frankly speaking, Riko... doesn't feel good telling you about all of this. (Sigh)

units.rawText: So the only thing wrong with these agents is that their neural cloud levels exceeded the Sanctifiers' limits? There's nothing else?
units.displayText: So the only thing wrong with these agents is that their neural cloud levels exceeded the Sanctifiers' limits? There's nothing else?

spans.text: So the only thing wrong with these agents is that their neural cloud levels exceeded the Sanctifiers' limits? There's nothing else?

units.rawText: Riko made contact with them before. From the way they behaved... They were all very normal, or perhaps I should say they were very pure.
units.displayText: Riko made contact with them before. From the way they behaved... They were all very normal, or perhaps I should say they were very pure.

spans.text: Riko made contact with them before. From the way they behaved... They were all very normal, or perhaps I should say they were very pure.

units.rawText: Professor, I'm starting to get a little worried. That Hannah which Turing wants us to protect is an Irregular Agent, and if there are any latent problems within her...
units.displayText: Professor, I'm starting to get a little worried. That Hannah which Turing wants us to protect is an Irregular Agent, and if there are any latent problems within her...

spans.text: Professor, I'm starting to get a little worried. That Hannah which Turing wants us to protect is an Irregular Agent, and if there are any latent problems within her...
(Analyze the situation.)
(Comfort Persicaria.)

units.rawText: If there were any other reason, the Sanctifiers wouldn't cover it up.
units.displayText: If there were any other reason, the Sanctifiers wouldn't cover it up.

spans.text: If there were any other reason, the Sanctifiers wouldn't cover it up.

units.rawText: Don't worry, Persicaria. We've met T1641 before, and she's just an ordinary kid. I'm pretty sure that Hannah which Turing wants us to protect is the same way.
units.displayText: Don't worry, Persicaria. We've met T1641 before, and she's just an ordinary kid. I'm pretty sure that Hannah which Turing wants us to protect is the same way.

spans.text: Don't worry, Persicaria. We've met T1641 before, and she's just an ordinary kid. I'm pretty sure that Hannah which Turing wants us to protect is the same way.

units.rawText: ...I feel much better after hearing you say that.
units.displayText: ...I feel much better after hearing you say that.

spans.text: ...I feel much better after hearing you say that.

units.rawText: Oh, I see, Riko understands now. You're doing all this for Turing, and you're protecting Hannah for... Oh! For operands.
units.displayText: Oh, I see, Riko understands now. You're doing all this for Turing, and you're protecting Hannah for... Oh! For operands.

spans.text: Oh, I see, Riko understands now. You're doing all this for Turing, and you're protecting Hannah for... Oh! For operands.

units.rawText: Dammit, how disgraceful. I can't believe that an Exchange employee like myself was outmaneuvered by an administrator.
units.displayText: Dammit, how disgraceful. I can't believe that an Exchange employee like myself was outmaneuvered by an administrator.

spans.text: Dammit, how disgraceful. I can't believe that an Exchange employee like myself was outmaneuvered by an administrator.

units.rawText: ...Turing made a deal with us before you did.
units.displayText: ...Turing made a deal with us before you did.

spans.text: ...Turing made a deal with us before you did.

units.rawText: It's a disgrace for a Trader to NOT be able to steal business from an administrator! Plus, not only did I not snatch it away, I even helped her deal along... Ahhhh! Riko's super mad now!
units.displayText: It's a disgrace for a Trader to NOT be able to steal business from an administrator! Plus, not only did I not snatch it away, I even helped her deal along... Ahhhh! Riko's super mad now!

spans.text: It's a disgrace for a Trader to NOT be able to steal business from an administrator! Plus, not only did I not snatch it away, I even helped her deal along... Ahhhh! Riko's super mad now!

units.rawText: ...Forget it, saving lives comes first, after all. Plus, Riko feels kind of sorry for those agents. After all, they did nothing wrong.
units.displayText: ...Forget it, saving lives comes first, after all. Plus, Riko feels kind of sorry for those agents. After all, they did nothing wrong.

spans.text: ...Forget it, saving lives comes first, after all. Plus, Riko feels kind of sorry for those agents. After all, they did nothing wrong.

units.displayText: Still, Riko doesn't understand why you need so many operands.

spans.text: Still, Riko doesn't understand why you need so many operands.

units.rawText: Ahem... Well, that's another question in its own right.
units.displayText: Ahem... Well, that's another question in its own right.

units.displayText: Beep~

units.displayText: Just then, a call comes in.

spans.text: Just then, a call comes in.

units.rawText: Oasis here. Croque hailing Persicaria, respond if you hear this, over.
units.displayText: Oasis here. Croque hailing Persicaria, respond if you hear this, over.

spans.text: Oasis here. Croque hailing Persicaria, respond if you hear this, over.

units.rawText: Croque, it's me, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Croque, it's me, Persicaria.

spans.text: Croque, it's me, Persicaria.

units.rawText: OK~ It's 15:55.00 now, and this is the first safety notification call as planned by the Professor. The Oasis is safe. I'll make the second call in 5 minutes' time.
units.displayText: OK~ It's 15:55.00 now, and this is the first safety notification call as planned by the Professor. The Oasis is safe. I'll make the second call in 5 minutes' time.

units.rawText: How are things on your side?
units.displayText: How are things on your side?

spans.text: How are things on your side?

units.rawText: Pretty good so far.
units.displayText: Pretty good so far.

spans.text: Pretty good so far.

units.rawText: Same over here at the Oasis. I'm checking for weak spots in the Sandbox Barrier when it's running at low efficiency.

spans.text: Same over here at the Oasis. I'm checking for weak spots in the Sandbox Barrier when it's running at low efficiency.

units.rawText: Those Sanctifiers are actually being pretty well-behaved, they won't be a problem for the time being, so long as you bring back ample operands as planned.

units.rawText: This was for the sake of evolving and progressing research into AI technology, so originally there was no problem, at least until the Magrasea cloud server went offline.
